Sean got the beat from "Turn Up" from Justin and made his own song called "I Don't Give A F*ck With You". 1/200:11Honest Trailers Commentary | The Year 2023 Skip Ad Continue watchingHonest Trailers Commentary | The Year 2023after the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEThe video player is currently playing an ad. You can skip the ad in 5 sec with a mouse or keyboardConnection[] Justin Bieber made a surprise appearance at Ariana Grande‘s concert on April 8, 2015 and got very flirty with her while on stage. Fans immediately began wondering what Big Sean, Ariana‘s boyfriend, thought about the performance. Sure enough, a tweet began floating around the Internet being attributed to Big Sean‘s account. “This kid is about to learn not to touch my girl like that. Beliebe that,” the tweet read. However, his rep told TMZ that the tweet is fake. Even though Ariana pushed Justin away, Sean believes it was all calculated by Ariana to hurt him.[1][2] “Justin tried to apologize for cuddling up to Ariana,” a source told HollywoodLife.com, “but before he could even finish his sentence Sean cut him off and said ‘don’t even worry about it, bro.’ They hugged it out and it’s all behind them.”[3] Credits[] 2011 One Girl unreleased vocals • writer 2012 As Long As You Love Me Believe vocals • writer 2012 Unknown[4] unreleased vocals • writer 2013 Memphis Journals vocals • writer 2015 No Pressure Purpose vocals • writer 2020 Harder Than My Demons Detroit 2 vocals • writer Gallery[] Videos[] BIG SEAN - FINALLY FAMOUS IN LONDONBig Sean talking about Justin Bieber collaboration in 2011 References[] ↑ "Big Sean -- Ariana Grande Used Justin Bieber as a Weapon to Hurt Me".
